claims.claim_text: The simulator takes pre-recorded videos from a forward-facing on-board camera on a human-driven data-collection vehicle and generates images that approximate what would appear if the CNN were, instead, steering the vehicle.
claims.normalized_text: The simulator uses pre-recorded videos from a human-driven vehicle to generate images simulating CNN steering.
claims.source_quote: The simulator takes pre-recorded videos from a forward-facing on-board camera on a human-driven data-collection vehicle and generates images that approximate what would appear if the CNN were, instead, steering the vehicle.
